args.description: 读取 video-search skill 的 SKILL.md 文件

args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/video-search
python /mnt/skills/custom/video-search/scripts/run.py --query Trafic --camera-id CAM_DEERFLOW_001 --labels person,car,bus,truck,motorcycle,bicycle --top-k 5 --index citybrain-video-library --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/video-search/result.json
